description: What the BORME published on one date: every registry act grouped by BORME section and province (company, act type, company slug). The raw day can hold thousands of acts, so the response gives exact counts per section and province plus the first `limit` acts per province (default 10). Narrow with `province` and/or `section` before raising the limit. `province` ignores case and accents and accepts part of a name of 3+ characters ("alava" finds "Araba/Álava"); if nothing matches, the response lists `available_provinces`. The BORME is not published on Sundays or national holidays (404), and this dataset may lag behind today: check borme_get_health (`latest_borme_processed`) if a recent date is missing.

date.description: Publication date, YYYY-MM-DD. BORME is not published on Sundays or national holidays (those dates return 404).

limit.description: Maximum acts returned per province, 1-200 (default 10). Counts always cover everything.

province.description: Only this province, e.g. "Madrid" or "Málaga". Case/accent-insensitive; a partial name of 3+ characters works ("alava" finds "Araba/Álava"). If nothing matches, the response lists available_provinces.

section.description: BORME section: "1" = Sección Primera (registered acts: constitutions, appointments, capital...), "2" = Sección Segunda (announcements and notices). Default: both.

name: borme_get_daily_summary
